result:
Group 1 is implemented and committed locally as `29c50f0` on branch `WPR-2-list-search-scroll`, but there is no PR. This run has no remote, so I skipped the push and `gh pr create`. All 7 tests (WP-01 to WP-06, with WP-02 run once per search term) were stable in 3 of 3 `verify` runs. I found no bugs, so no Bug tickets were filed.

- **Subtasks:** WPR-1 had none, so I created WPR-2 to WPR-5, one per group. WPR-2 is "List, search and scroll". It is now `impl-ready-for-review`, and the Subtask comment has the raw commit, verify verdicts and self-review.
- **Checks:** `tsc` is clean and `lint` has 0 errors. The one existing warning is the `waitForTimeout` in `src/utils/helper.ts`. `format:check` still flags `CLAUDE.md` and `.mcp.json`, which were already unformatted and which I didn't touch. `plan-coverage` shows WP-01 to WP-06 implemented with no tag mismatch; the other 19 scenarios belong to the later groups.
- **Page objects:** The repo had none, so I built the wiring and the shared components in `pages/`. I added the `app` fixture, `AppPageObjects` and `WallpapersListPage`. The shared pieces are `HeaderPage`, `FooterPage`, `MainHeaderPage`, `CardGrid` and `CardLinkValidator`, parameterised so ringtones can reuse them. I also added a `FiltersBar` with default-state checks only; group 2 extends it.
- **Departures from the command:**
  - I did not use the `playwright-test-generator` agent. I wrote the page objects and tests myself, from locators I probed on production.
  - I removed the wallpapers ignore from the area ESLint rules, as the Story asks for group 1.
  - I dropped the `Co-Authored-By` line because CLAUDE.md forbids it.
- **Self-review:** I reviewed `git diff main...HEAD` against the CLAUDE.md rules and the plan scenarios and found nothing to fix.
- **Next:** Groups 2 to 4 (WPR-3, WPR-4, WPR-5) are not started; each needs its own `/implement-ticket` run.

Everything is committed, so there is no `git add` block to paste. Merging is yours.
